column1: # xbios-system-r1.tsv -- DUMPBIOS, audit xbios-system (2026-10-28): the XBIOS
# system calls without disk access -- Protobt, Cursconf, NVMaccess -- with
# Added by the auditor (docs/audits/2026-10-28-xbios-system.md, section 5) as
# a table of its own, so bios-r1.tsv, its CRC and its references stay as they
# are.  Every row is inside the round-1 guard of tosdump/core/cases.c
# (call_policy): Protobt with a dumper buffer, Cursconf only function 5,
# NVMaccess only a read into a dumper buffer (or NULL) or an invalid op.
# Protobt's buffer is poisoned with the bytes DE AD before every case
# (docs/TOS-REFERENCE-DUMPER.md section 6): its word checksum is 0xAD00, not
# 0x1234, so every row starts from a non-executable sector.  The executable
# start state, the random-serial value and Random's sequence need state a
# call table cannot set up; the audit measured them with a probe.
# Settime, the set arms of Cursconf and Setprt, and NVMaccess write/reset are
# refused by the guard: probe territory too.
# -XBIOS-system-falcontc.  One table per round: frozen once measured.
# every disktype: the BPB template (bytes 11..29) and the checksum at 510
# disktype out of range: the BPB stays as it was
